Milo Yiannopoulos (born October 18, 1984) is a British far-right political commentator and writer known for his involvement in right-wing media and politics. As an editor at [[Breitbart News]], he gained prominence for his bigoted articles. In 2017, he resigned from Breitbart following backlash over comments that were percived to condone pedophilia. 

In 2022, Yiannopoulos served as an intern for U.S. Congresswoman [[Marjorie Taylor Greene]]. During this time, he was accused of using Greene's campaign funds to purchase a website domain for [[Kanye West]]'s presidential campaign. He later worked on West's 2024 presidential bid, briefly holding the position of chief of staff at Yeezy Apparel before stepping down in May 2024.
